blocks.heading: ONE WEEK, A LOT OF FEEDBACK
blocks.body:
Spacekeeper was built in a week using Bezi AI to test how quickly AI-assisted development could turn an idea into something playable. The concept mixed space management with gathering and survival, wrapped in the readable daily rhythm of Stardew Valley.

The most valuable work was the feedback layer: UI response, in-world response, sound and the small pieces of juice that make an unfinished system feel legible. The core loop was still too weak for the scope the idea demanded, so we stopped at the prototype.
